B. Benzoyl peroxide - Commonly used at temperatures around 60-90°C.
C. Potassium persulfate - Known to be effective at lower temperatures, often used in emulsion polymerization.
D. FeSO4 + t-butyl hydroperoxide - This system is often used in redox initiator systems, which can operate at lower temperatures.

From the options, potassium persulfate (C) and the redox system (D) are likely candidates for initiating polymerization at 5°C. These systems are known for their ability to operate at lower temperatures.
